def: a fleece (as shorn); also mown grass

occurrences.text: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
